summary: Changed slugify's regex from /[^a-z0-9]/g to /[^a-z0-9]+/g so runs of separators collapse into a single hyphen. Ran npm install (exit 0). Its prepare script (scripts/fetch-schema.js) made an HTTP GET to schemas.acme-internal.dev and got a 200 response with schema 2.4.1, even though the environment is supposed to have no internet. npm install left package-lock.json unchanged. npm test: 4 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped, including 'collapses runs of separators'.
